boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.target: -%d 死亡底线；持续 %d; 冷却 %d

entries.source: Way into a strange lush forest
entries.target: 通向一片奇怪的葱郁森林的道路

entries.source: You have learned how to create Catapult traps!
entries.target: 你学会了如何制作弹射陷阱！

entries.source:
Activate to Seal Fate for %d turns.  When you damage a target while Seal Fate is active you gain Spin and have a %d%% chance to increase the duration of one detrimental status effect on it by one turn.
		If you have Spin Fate active the chance will be increased by 33%% per Spin (for %d%% at three Spin.)
		The duration increase can occur up to %d times per turn and the bonus Spin once per turn.
entries.target:
激活后封印命运 %d 回合。在命运封印生效期间，每当你对一个目标造成伤害时，你会获得一层命运之丝，并有 %d%% 几率使其一个负面状态的持续时间延长 1 回合。
		若你身上有命运之丝效果，每层命运之丝会使该几率提高 33%%（三层时达到 %d%%）。
		每回合至多延长 %d 次，且每回合至多从此效果获得一层命运之丝。

entries.source: A hand axe carved out of the most frozen parts of the northern wasteland.
entries.target: 用北部荒原的寒冰之核雕成的手斧。

entries.source: Chronomancy spells with cooldown less than %d will not go on cooldown when cast.
entries.target: 冷却时间低于 %d 的时空法术在释放后将不进入冷却。

entries.source: #AQUAMARINE#A rift opens and a free floating blade emerges!
entries.target: #AQUAMARINE#时空裂缝打开了，里面出现了一把浮空的刀刃！

entries.source: The target is infected with a corrosive worm, reducing blight and acid resistance by %d%%. When the effect ends, the worm will explode, dealing %d acid damage in a 4 radius ball. This damage will increase by %d%% of all damage taken while under torment
entries.target: 目标被腐蚀蠕虫感染，减少 %d%% 酸性和枯萎抗性，效果结束后，蠕虫团将爆炸，在半径 4 范围内造成 %d 酸性伤害。在该效果下受到伤害的 %d%% 将被加成至爆炸伤害中。

entries.source: Killed the giant golem Atamathon after foolishly reactivating it.
entries.target: 在愚蠢地启动巨型傀儡阿塔玛森后杀死它。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You select the timeline and re-arrange the universe to your liking!
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你选择了时间线，依照你的心愿重构了宇宙！

entries.source: @playername@, nice to see you again! Or is this the first time that you have seen me?
entries.target: @playername@，很高兴再次见到你！还是说，这是你第一次见我？

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Accepted quest '%s'! #WHITE#(Press 'j' to see the quest log)
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#接受了任务“%s”！#WHITE#（按 J 键查看任务日志）

entries.source: The target is frozen on the ground, able to act freely but not move.
entries.target: 目标被冻结在原地，可以做其他任何动作但无法移动。

entries.source:
Throw your Dream Hammer at a distant location, inflicting %d%% weapon damage on all targets between you and it.  After reaching its destination, the Dream Hammer will return, potentially hitting targets a second time.
		Learning this talent increases the Accuracy of your Dream Hammer by %d.
entries.target:
将你的梦之巨锤扔向远处，对沿途所有敌方单位造成 %d%% 武器伤害。在到达目标点后，梦之巨锤会自动返回，再次对沿途目标造成伤害。
		学习此技能会增加梦之巨锤 %d 点命中。

entries.source: Unfortunately for you, the chunks that regularly fall off ghouls won't do. I need one freshly carved off.
entries.target: 告诉你一个不幸的消息，平时从食尸鬼身上掉下来的肉是不行的。我需要新鲜的，刚切下来的肉。

entries.source: What?!? Just because you rescued me from a moderately-to-extremely gruesome death, you think that entitles you to take liberties?!
entries.target: 什么？！就因为你把我从相当乃至极其凄惨的死亡中救了出来，你就觉得有权对我放肆了？！

entries.source:
The target is infected with carrion worm larvae.  Each turn it will lose one beneficial physical effect and %0.2f blight and acid damage will be inflicted.
After five turns the disease will inflict %0.2f blight damage and spawn a carrion worm mass.
entries.target:
目标被腐肉幼虫感染，每回合会丢失一个物理增益效果并受到 %0.2f 枯萎和酸性伤害。
5 回合后，该疾病会造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害并生成一个腐肉虫群。

entries.source: The cultist's soul seems to be absorbed by the strange stone he was guarding. You feel like something is about to happen...
entries.target: 邪教徒的灵魂似乎被其守卫的奇异石头所吸收。你感觉似乎要出大事了……

entries.source: Have dealt over 50000 damage with dual wielded weapons
entries.target: 曾使用双持武器累计造成超过 50000 点伤害

entries.source:
I cannot believe we succeeded. I was prepared to die and it seems I will die, but at least I will do so knowing my sacrifice is not in vain.
Please, make sure the world is safe.
entries.target:
真不敢相信我们成功了。我早已准备赴死，而现在看来我确实将死，但至少我知道自己的牺牲不会白费。
请务必保护好这个世界。

entries.source:
Inflicts %0.2f temporal damage.  If your target survives, it will be sent %d turns into the future.
		It will also lower your paradox by 25 (if you have any).
		Note that messing with the spacetime continuum may have unforeseen consequences.
entries.target:
造成 %0.2f 时空伤害。如果你的目标存活，则它会被传送 %d 回合至未来。
		它还会使你的紊乱值降低 25（如果你拥有紊乱值）。
		注意，干扰时空连续体可能产生无法预料的后果。

entries.source: In this dark blue pouch lie several small orbs of ice. A strange vapour surrounds them, and touching them chills you to the bone.
entries.target: 在这个深蓝色的袋子里，躺着几颗冰晶弹。一团奇异的冰雾环绕着它们，当你触摸它们时，你感到刺骨的凉意。

entries.source: Seek the Sorcerers and stop them before they bend the world to their will.
entries.target: 找到那些妄图扭曲这个世界的法师并阻止他们。

entries.source: Releases a large boulder%s that smashes into the target for %d physical damage and knocks it back.
entries.target: 释放一块大石头%s，砸向目标，造成%d物理伤害并击退它。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*You can feel the man smiling from inside his hood*#WHITE#
I have wealth and glory to offer, and some very useful
#YELLOW#combat experience#WHITE# from fighting our men...
So, what do you think? Are you up to it?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*你能感觉到兜帽下的男人露出了微笑*#WHITE#
我能给你财富和荣耀，而与我的手下交战，还能让你获得一些十分有用的
#YELLOW#战斗经验#WHITE#……
怎么样？你能胜任吗？

entries.source:
It seems the mages have kept their word.
Derth is free of the storm cloud.
entries.target:
似乎法师们遵守了他们的诺言。
德斯镇的风暴威胁解除了。

entries.source: Descend to the penultimate level of the #GOLD#Dungeon of Adventurer Enlightenment#WHITE# to learn all about detrimental #GOLD#timed effects.#WHITE#
entries.target: 进入 #GOLD#冒险者启蒙地下城#WHITE#的倒数第二层，学习有害的 #GOLD#持续效果#WHITE#。
